name: Chickpea Caesar Lettuce Wraps with Parmesan & Toasted Bread Crumbs
instructions: Drain and rinse chickpeas; set aside to drain further.
Place mayo, dressing, and spices in a medium bowl. Stir to combine.
Add chickpeas to the bowl with the dressing. Mash with a fork or potato masher until combined and chickpeas are crushed, but still have some texture.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and small dice celery. Add to the bowl.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl.
Add Parmesan to the bowl and stir to combine the chickpea salad; set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add bread crumbs and toast, stirring frequently, until golden brown, 3-4 minutes. Transfer toasted bread crumbs to a small bowl, then add additional garlic powder and salt; stir to combine.
Separate the lettuce into leaves. Pile leaves, in stacks of two per wrap, onto plates; fill with chickpea salad, then top with bread crumbs and additional Parmesan. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
